record_id: Unique release observation ID; identifies a source observation, not a geographic seat.
election_gp_key: Immutable source-election record key. Historical keys use source row ordinals; 2021 uses publisher candidate IDs.
source_record_id: Publisher candidate ID in 2021; unavailable for earlier GP records.
source_row_number: One-based original source-table row before filtering winner markers.
source_file: Source table filename; GP sources resolve within data/release/gp.
election_year: Election-cycle year attributed by the registered source; not an exact polling date.
office: Standardized office label; rural heads, members, deputies and urban offices remain distinct.
record_kind: Source record unit: candidate, winner-marked/listed winner, official, reservation, or source-status notice.
source_collection: Source registry entry responsible for this observation.
source_observation_id: Original observation identifier retained from the registered parent artifact.
source_artifact_path: Repository-relative parent CSV or Parquet artifact used by the adapter.
source_artifact_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact parent artifact bytes.
source_artifact_row: One-based physical row within the parent artifact.
source_document_sha256: Source content hash interpreted according to source_document_hash_basis.
source_local_path: Current source locator relative to the UP repository; archive members use archive#member.
source_url: Recorded source URL where available; a URL does not identify immutable bytes.
source_response_path: Saved acquisition response locator where available.
source_page: Recorded source page locator; null where page lineage is unavailable.
source_row: Source row locator; its original field is named in source_row_field.
source_row_field: Name of the incoming field used for the source-row locator.
source_csv_record: One-based CSV data-record ordinal, excluding the header.
source_line_start: First physical line of the CSV record, including header offset.
source_line_end: Last physical line of the CSV record; quoted multiline cells may span lines.
source_copy_group: Hash-based group of identical statewide source copies consolidated in the export.
source_artifact_format: Storage format of the parent artifact, such as csv or parquet.
source_document_role: Distinguishes original source documents, local exports, and derived intermediates.
source_document_hash_basis: Whether the hash covers stored bytes, decompressed gzip content, or an archive member.
source_path_resolution_status: hash_verified means the source locator resolved to matching bytes, not that its claims were validated.
reservation_class: general, obc, sc, st, or unknown seat reservation. Unknown is not general/unreserved.
women_reserved: True/1 for a women-reserved seat, false/0 for a known non-women-reserved seat, null if unknown.
candidate_category_raw: Source candidate/person category, separate from the reservation of the seat.
seat_reservation_raw: Original source seat-reservation label before normalization.
candidate_category_class: Decoded candidate/person category; never substituted for the seat reservation.
candidate_category_women_label: Whether the candidate-category label itself includes a women designation.
assignment_usable: False for all provisional office observations. Mechanical validation does not certify an assignment.
quality_flags: Unresolved source, parsing, provenance, or interpretation conditions; multiple flags can apply.
is_winner: True for an asserted listed/elected winner; null for unresolved conflicts or sources that do not assert a winner.
winner_markers_conflict: More than one candidate carries a winner marker under the same 2021 source seat key.
winner_woman: 1 for a source-reported female winner, 0 for male, null for missing sex or a conflicting winner claim.
winner_sex_hindi: Original reported sex of the winner-marked/listed source person; does not resolve conflicting winner claims.
pradhan_name_hindi: Source person name. In 2021 uses the actual candidate field, preserving both conflicting names.
pradhan_name_eng_raw: Saved English transliteration; null when the denormalized name cannot identify a conflicting winner.
candidate_name_raw: Original candidate or official name attached to this source observation.
result_raw: Source result label; for 2015 winner lists it means contested or unopposed.
result_status_hindi: Contested/unopposed for 2015, publisher winner marker for 2021, missing in older GP sources.
valid_votes: Parsed count of valid votes where explicitly stated; invalid source tokens remain null and flagged.
vote_percentage: Source-stated vote share in percentage points, not a vote count.
poll_percentage: Source-stated turnout percentage; values outside 0–100 remain unresolved.
candidate_age: Source-reported age parsed as an integer where available.
gp_number_raw: Original block-local GP number/serial. It is not a global geographic identifier.
normalized_name_key: Election-year district/block/GP normalized-name combination; may collide.
normalized_name_key_n: Number of records with this normalized-name key in the election year.
link_eligible: True only where normalized district/block/GP components exist and their combined key is unique.
lgd_gp_code: Mapped Local Government Directory GP code; not proof of unchanged historical boundaries.
lgd_gp_name: Name attached to the mapped LGD code in the registered directory vintage.
lgd_block_code: Mapped LGD block code from the reviewed block correspondence.
lgd_gp_linked: Whether a GP linkage was accepted; an unlinked row is not a zero-valued match.
lgd_gp_link_method: Accepted exact or reviewed/scored geographic linkage method.
lgd_gp_link_score: Recorded similarity score for the linkage method, not a calibrated probability.
name_override_used: Whether a reviewed source-record-specific geographic name override was applied.
district_name_alias_used: Whether an approved district-name alias was applied.
block_xwalk_used: Whether an approved block crosswalk was applied.
block_name_alias_used: Whether the reviewed block mapping changed the normalized block label.
left_id: Source-election record ID in the earlier wave of a geographic link.
right_id: Source-election record ID in the later wave of a geographic link.
decision: Linkage decision, including accepted, tied, competing-script, or nonreciprocal cases.
match_method: Geographic comparison method used for a linkage decision.
match_distance: String distance used by the stated matching method; smaller values indicate greater similarity.
panel: Election-wave combination represented by this linkage or historical LGD row.
anchor_key: Source-election ID chosen as the historical geographic anchor.
anchor_year: Election year supplying the historical geographic anchor.
mapping_review_id: Reviewed identity decision supporting a historical LGD mapping, where present.
text_encoding: Whether the reported labels are Unicode or retained legacy-font encodings.
name_reading_uncertain: Whether the source-name reading remains uncertain; null does not certify identity.
ward_number: Parsed office ward number where the source supports that interpretation.
membership_ward_number: Ward attached to membership; it is not necessarily the ward of the office described.
id: Publisher candidate identifier in the 2021 candidate table.
candidate: Publisher's actual candidate name, distinct from the denormalized elected_sarpanch_name field.
gp_id: Identifier within the external Weaver source vintage; cross-wave meaning differs between vintages.
original_filename: Original parsed document filename, retained for document/page provenance.
page: Recorded page locator in the original parsed document.
gp_code: Source-local GP serial; never use alone as a cross-block identifier.
elected_sarpanch_name: Saved source winner-name field; 2021 values are denormalized and must not resolve conflicting candidate markers.
